calls.statement:
SELECT
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  p.subcategory,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line AS f
INNER JOIN dim_date AS d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_store AS s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON p.product_key = f.product_key AND p.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id != 999
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10
